acceptance_evidence: validate_shiki green; new python unittest passes under unittest discover; shell init/start tests assert the new gh api PUT; ADR present under docs/adr/
completion_conditions: shiki_github.py exposes configure_workflow_permissions() that PUTs repos/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow with default_workflow_permissions=read and can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true
cmd_bootstrap_github and cmd_init call it within the --protect provisioning block (skipped by --no-protect), and the dry-run plan lists a workflow-permissions line
a python unittest under tests/ asserts the PUT payload, discoverable by 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests'; test_shiki_init.sh/test_shiki_start.sh stub+assert the new gh api call
an ADR records the can_approve_pull_request_reviews bootstrap default and its CCA-Review-Bridge / solo-maintainer security tradeoff
non_goals: Changing branch protection payload or required checks
Org-level Actions policy; hard-failing bootstrap when the API call is rejected (warn only, doctor already diagnoses)
Any change to CubeShare or other target repos directly
outcome: shiki init / start / bootstrap-platform automatically set the target repo's Actions workflow permission so GitHub Actions may create and approve pull requests (can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true, default_workflow_permissions=read), removing the manual Settings -> Actions -> General step that the CCA Review Bridge depends on.
title: Bootstrap auto-grants GitHub Actions create/approve-PR permission to Shiki targets
